Hello,

Our driver, Livia Klaveren, is bringing the Ferrari Roma (DEMO-FI-LR9VRY) to Usvaharjunpolku 85, Helsinki. The delivery window is 13:00-15:00 EEST today.

The courtyard vehicle gate is confirmed. We have not confirmed three things for this delivery:
1. Whether someone will be there to receive the car, and whether the appointment the site requires is booked.
2. Whether Phoebe Marlfield or another named person may take the car and sign for it.
3. Who will hold the keys.

Could you confirm these, or give us a phone number for the person on site? The driver is waiting for your answer before handing over the car.

Kind regards,
Bahn Road Desk

I've drafted a customer-contact proposal for CD-420619. It needs an operator's approval before anything is sent.

Nobody has confirmed who will be there, whether the required appointment is booked, who may sign for the car, or who holds the keys. The site belongs to the customer, so only an operator can ask them.

The draft email asks Orelvian Premium Cars to confirm those points before handover. The delivery window is 13:00–15:00 EEST.

I don't know where the car is. The driver app showed 81 km remaining at 08:23 UTC. The simulated phone position puts the car near the delivery address, but its 09:50 UTC timestamp is later than the current clock, so I'd treat it as unreliable.

I have not cleared the driver. They were told to stay where they are until an operator decides.
